My dear [Christabel](../persons.html#329)
You and [Mary Arnold](../persons.html#1467) are very decidedly the best this time, so I don’t send any others.

You will have to reform the scheme of travelling as [Mignonette](../persons.html#1637) and [Sparrow Hawk](../persons.html#97) both resign in much haste[^1]
yr affect
Mother Goose

[^1]: The circulation of essays between the various members of the [Gosling Society](../others.html#104) caused endless trouble.
